speaker: dad
igboText: Nwa m, ị hụla nnukwu akpa m?
englishText: Honey, have you seen my big bag?
statement: Dad asks his daughter if she has seen his big bag.
falseStatement: Dad asks his daughter where his small pen is.

speaker: daughter
igboText: Nke nta ọcha dị n'elu tebụl ahụ?
englishText: The little white one on the table?
statement: The daughter asks if he means the little white one on the table.
falseStatement: The daughter asks if he means the red one under the chair.

speaker: dad
statement: Dad says no and rejects that one.
falseStatement: Dad says yes, that is the exact one.

speaker: daughter
statement: The daughter asks if he means the blue one.
falseStatement: The daughter asks if he means the black one.

speaker: daughter
statement: The daughter asks if he means the new one.
falseStatement: The daughter asks if he means the broken one.

speaker: dad
igboText: Mba. Ana m achọ nke ochie.
englishText: No. I'm looking for the old one.
statement: Dad says he is looking for the old one.
falseStatement: Dad says he is looking for the new one.

speaker: daughter
englishText: The one with the red cover?
statement: The daughter asks if he means the one with the red cover.
falseStatement: The daughter asks if he means the one with the blue cover.

speaker: dad
igboText: Ee! Nke ahụ ka m na-achọ.
englishText: Yes! That's the one I'm looking for.
statement: Dad confirms that is the one he wants.
falseStatement: Dad says that is not the one he wants.

speaker: daughter
igboText: Papa, akwụkwọ ndetu gị nwere mkpuchi uhie.
englishText: Dad, your notebook has a red cover.
statement: The daughter says his notebook has a red cover.
falseStatement: The daughter says his bag has a yellow cover.

speaker: dad
igboText: Nwa m, achọghị m akwụkwọ ndetu.
englishText: My child, I don't want a notebook.
statement: Dad says he does not want a notebook.
falseStatement: Dad says he really wants a notebook.

speaker: daughter
statement: The daughter asks to confirm he does not want a notebook.
falseStatement: The daughter asks if he wants two notebooks.

speaker: dad
igboText: Mba. Achọrọ m leta onye odeakwụkwọ dere.
englishText: No. I want a letter written by a secretary.
statement: Dad says he wants a letter written by a secretary.
falseStatement: Dad says he wants a drawing from a student.

speaker: daughter
igboText: Nke nnukwu nwere mkpuchi uhie ahụ?
englishText: The big one with the red cover?
statement: The daughter asks if he means the big one with the red cover.
falseStatement: The daughter asks if he means the small one with the red cover.

speaker: daughter
igboText: Ah! Anyị na-achọ akwụkwọ ọgụgụ, ọ bụghị akwụkwọ ndetu gị! 😄
englishText: Ah! We're looking for textbooks, not your notebook! 😄
statement: The daughter jokes that they are looking for textbooks, not his notebook.
falseStatement: The daughter says they are looking for his notebook only.
